prompt: Slightly high angle from a little above head height with a 28mm lens on a wet cobbled quay at night, looking down so the shining stones and river fill the background. The singer is big in the foreground, his upturned face a third of the frame high, three-quarter to us, jaw wide, lit red from one side and green from the other. Behind him, small and shouting with heads back: a tubby young Italian American trumpeter of about 25, a slim woman drummer of about 35 with bobbed black hair, a Black upright bass player of about 60, tall and white-haired, and a wiry fingerpicking guitarist of about 70, bald. Stacked barrels burn on the quay beyond; the river runs red and green with reflections. No lettering, no black bars. Thanks.
